clues.title: Google car: Gibraltar silver tip antenna
text: That long antenna with a silver tip on google car is mostly found in Gibraltar.
It's British Overseas Territory so you will see a lot of English, UK license plates(back yellow, front white) but remember that Gibraltar drives on the right.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Google car: White Tip Antenna
text: All coverage in Gibraltar is Generation 3.
The car will always have a unique long antenna with a silver tip, often referred to simply as the “Gibraltar antenna” by the community.
This antenna can also be found in parts of Spain, but nowhere else in Europe.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Plate: Yellow License Plates
text: Like the UK, Gibraltar uses yellow back plates on vehicles.
However, note that unlike the UK, Gibraltar drives on the right.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
